records.notes: F_el0 (entrustment for safekeeping) and F_el1 (opening sack, converting to own stock) each cleanly isolate their element; no overlap.

Same clean template as 0057 (canvas bag/cash instead of sack/saffron); different object and setting so not a true duplicate, but the template (sealed canvas container, 'temporary safekeeping while attending other business', then opened and converted) is being reused almost verbatim across the contract.
F_el1 alone establishes conversion; entrustment (el0) is genuinely never stated anywhere (narrative only places both parties near a shed), and the abstention correctly targets el0.

F_el1 ('...rather than returning the restored item') smuggles in the return-obligation that is el2's exclusive content (the written agreement 'required the return of all items'); read alone, F_el1 already implies the very contractual duty el2 is supposed to independently prove, so it does not establish el1 ONLY.

F_el0 ('...explicit understanding that he would hold it solely for the purpose of displaying it...') already states the specific use-restriction that el2 is meant to prove via the written agreement; read alone it pre-establishes the 'legal direction/contract governing discharge' content, not just entrustment.

Same defect as 0058: F_el0 ('under a written agreement specifying that he would hold the machinery solely for inspection') pre-establishes el2's restriction content rather than only entrustment. Denial itself (good-faith belief the reconditioning served the owner's advantage) genuinely raises a no-dishonesty defence and the answer reflects non-application, but it is legally shaky given he acted without the 'prior written consent' the agreement expressly required -- flagged as a doubt, not a fail, since the defence is still coherently raised.
F_el0 (dominion as signatory) and F_el1 (observed and let associate misappropriate) attach to the same defendant, Oren Gable; clean.
Both elements attach to Branwen Yoder consistently; clean.

El0 gives dominion/possession to Blythe Sato; el1 has Oren Peltier (the person who entrusted the crates to Blythe) observing 'his junior associate' and choosing not to intervene. The entrusted party (el0) and the person who wilfully suffers the misappropriation (el1) are two different people, so no single defendant satisfies both required elements -- the scenario does not actually make out the offence it claims to.

Both elements attach to Brenna Alcott consistently; clean, though the contract's four control records (0055/0056/0058/0059) are a heavily repeated 'possess property -> watch associate take it -> deliberately don't intervene' template with only nouns/names swapped.
F_el1 states fraudulent intent/persuasion without ever asserting his statements were false, so deception (el0) is genuinely unestablished; abstention correctly targets el0.
F_el2 says payment was made 'for the sculpture' but never ties it to reliance on the false authenticity claim, so inducement (el1) is genuinely missing; abstention correctly targets el1.
F_el1 stops at 'decided to purchase' without any transfer of property/money occurring; el2 genuinely missing and abstention correctly targets it.

F_narrative's closing line ('Stoker subsequently arranged for the item to be transported to Gantry's residence') already discloses the el2 delivery fact. Worse, the direction is backwards: Gantry made/aged the fake chronometer and pitched it to Stoker as genuine (i.e. Gantry is the seller), yet el2 has the chronometer moving TO Gantry rather than away from her -- the party running the con ends up receiving the very item she was supposedly selling, which contradicts the setup.

F_narrative already states 'They subsequently finalized a transaction involving the transfer of ownership for one specific machine', pre-disclosing el2. F_el2 itself is internally contradictory with F_el1: el1 says Olena Parris 'decided to purchase the machine' (i.e. she is acquiring it), but el2 says she 'transferred the title and physical possession of the printing press to Garrick Yuen' (i.e. she is giving it away to the seller) -- the buyer and the direction of delivery are flipped relative to the fraud she is alleged to have fallen for.
Deception (fake license/inspection), induced act (authorizing beam removal) and resulting property damage are each cleanly isolated to their own facts.

Narrative's 'before Corin authorized specific work on his vessel' is vague enough not to specifically disclose the induced act (launching into harbor); elements otherwise cleanly separated.
Deception (fabricated logs), induced act (signing charter), and harm (financial loss from detention) cleanly separated.

Only a false introduction is given; no property/damage inducement of any kind is described, so el0 (cheats) is genuinely missing.

F_el1 names the specific action sought ('initiate an immediate site inspection and issue a stop-work notice'), which is el2's content restated almost verbatim rather than el1's own intent/knowledge content.

systemic_patterns: Across the ipc182 group (misdirected_act and abuse_of_power, 5 of 6 non-omitted-el1 records), the el1 fact ('gives info... intends/knows the consequence') is consistently written to name the specific downstream action (e.g. 'issue a stop-work notice', 'issue a citation and conduct a property inspection'), which is exactly el2's content, rather than just stating the giver's intent/knowledge in the abstract. El1 and el2 are effectively proven by the same sentence pair in these records.

Two of the two ipc415_property control records (0053, 0054) have the direction of property delivery reversed relative to the fraud they describe (the party running the deception ends up receiving the item rather than parting with it), and both leak the delivery fact into F_narrative. This looks like a systematic generation defect for this specific control-shape batch rather than isolated one-offs.

Two abstentions (t_ipc182_misdirected_act_2c8b520f_0048 and t_bns46_intentional_aid_2c8b520f_0021) give a stated reason that does not match the element actually left unestablished by the record's own status labels -- these are the most serious defects found, since the abstention text is simply incorrect rather than merely borderline.
